# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_journal_map_scales.py — do not edit manually.
# The Map Room's maps fitted to the world (te_journal_map_scales_generated.txt). Each te_jmap_range_<map>
# measures a map's range into te_jmap_rng_<map>_lo / _hi: it counts the states the map paints with a figure
# (te_jmap_n), works out how many each end leaves out (te_jmap_k), and has te_jmap_measure_at take the state
# at that place from the top and from the bottom (te_jmap_measure_<map>, K a literal: position takes no
# script value). By default the 5th highest and the 5th lowest; never past the middle of a short list; no
# state with a figure, and the globals stay unset (the fixed curve's ends). A range the Map Room reads counts
# only the states in the Map Room's area (te_jmap_in_area) and takes its Outliers option's trim
# (te_jmap_trim_count); a range a system's own entry reads (te_jmap_range_gw, _gm) is the whole world's on the
# default trim, whatever the options, and the Map Room reads its twin (_room). Any scope: every_state and
# ordered_state walk the world's states. te_jmap_refresh_range measures the pick's map (te_jmap_set_selector
# and te_jmap_apply_options, te_journal_map_effects.txt; and monthly, te_journal_map_on_actions.txt),
# te_jmap_refresh_entry_ranges the entries' own.

# Turmoil, the radicals' share: half the color by a fifth of the world's range, the rest more slowly.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_turmoil = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = turmoil }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_turmoil = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
	}
}

# Global Warming: the state's share of the world's emissions last year (a share, owner 2026-11-06): half the color by a fifth of the world's range; a thousand-odd states average 0.1%.

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_lo

		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi

	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis te_jmap_gw_world > 0 te_jmap_gw_state_emis >= 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count_entry }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = gw }
}

	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis te_jmap_gw_world > 0 te_jmap_gw_state_emis >= 0 }

		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi value = te_jmap_gw_input }

te_jmap_measure_gm = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_gm_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_gm_hi value = te_jmap_gm_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_gm_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_gm_lo value = te_jmap_gm_input }
	}
}

# Grand Monuments: the state's grandeur, two-thirds of the color by a third of the world's range.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_gm_room = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = gm_room }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_gm_room = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes te_jmap_in_area = yes }

		position = $K$

		position = $K$

# Tourism's Base Appeal, the state panel's row, 0-1 (stored monthly by te_update_tourism_modifier); 0.2 is the score of a region the table doesn't list.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_tourism = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = tourism }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_tourism = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_tourism_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_tourism_hi value = te_jmap_tourism_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_tourism_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_tourism_lo value = te_jmap_tourism_input }
	}
}

# GDP per capita, a year's GDP per person in pounds: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low to its high (a rich country about 1 in 1836, 8 in 1917, 60 today).
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_gdppc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo

		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_hi

	every_state = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = gdppc }

	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}

		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_fam_hi value = te_jmap_fam_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_fam has_variable = te_dg_people te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_fam_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_fam_lo value = te_jmap_fam_input }
	}
}

		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_loyal_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_loyal_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_loyal_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = loyal }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_loyal = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_loyal_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_loyal_hi value = te_jmap_loyal_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_loyal_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_loyal_lo value = te_jmap_loyal_input }
	}
}

	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_shopkeepers has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_share_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_class_shopkeepers_share_lo value = te_jmap_class_shopkeepers_share_input }
	}
}

		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_laborers var:te_dg_cls_laborers > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = class_laborers }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_class_laborers = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_laborers var:te_dg_cls_laborers > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_class_laborers_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_hi value = te_jmap_class_laborers_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_laborers var:te_dg_cls_laborers > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_class_laborers_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_class_laborers_lo value = te_jmap_class_laborers_input }
	}
}

		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_officers has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = class_officers_share }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_class_officers_share = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_officers has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_class_officers_share_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_hi value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_officers has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_class_officers_share_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_class_officers_share_lo value = te_jmap_class_officers_share_input }
	}
}

# ---- Ranked (the Scale option): each state's place in line, stored for the paint ----
# te_jmap_rank_<map> walks the states the map measures (those in the Map Room's area), lowest figure
# first, and stores each one's place as te_jmap_rank, 0 to 1, which te_jmap_<map>_factor reads under
# Ranked. Equal figures share a place, and each distinct figure is one step. A map with a meaningful
# midpoint is ranked on each side of it, outward, so the midpoint keeps its color. The walk is
# ordered_state with min = 0 and max = 5000 (a place is a count the body keeps, not a position);
# the pass after it divides each place by the last. Each map by its own figure, though Current Comfort
# shares Base Comfort's range. te_jmap_refresh_range runs the pick's after its range, having cleared
# every place first: a pick, an option click and each month's pulse.

# Every place off every state, where any was stored (te_jmap_ranks).
te_jmap_clear_ranks = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks }
		every_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
			remove_variable = te_jmap_rank
		}
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	}
}

# Turmoil, the radicals' share: half the color by a fifth of the world's range, the rest more slowly.
te_jmap_rank_turmoil = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# From the lowest: 0 to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_turmoil_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# Devastation, a 0-1 share as turmoil is (te_demog_crisis reads it bare): half the color by a fifth of the world's range.
te_jmap_rank_devastation = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# From the lowest: 0 to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_devastation_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_devastation_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_devastation_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# Dynastic Wealth, the state's score, split at 50, where its effects turn from dispersed to concentrated property.
te_jmap_rank_wc = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# Below the midpoint, the nearest first: 0.5 down to 0.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = 1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_wc_input < 50 }
		order_by = te_jmap_wc_input
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_wc_input < te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_wc_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_wc_input < 50 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_low }
	}
	# Above it, the nearest first: 0.5 up to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_wc_input > 50 }
		order_by = te_jmap_wc_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_wc_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_wc_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_wc_input > 50 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_up }
	}
	# At the midpoint itself: its color.
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_wc te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_wc_input = 50 }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = 0.5 }
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_stepped var:te_dg_stepped > 0 has_variable = te_dg_mig_rate te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_mig_input > 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_up }
	}
	# At the midpoint itself: its color.
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_stepped var:te_dg_stepped > 0 has_variable = te_dg_mig_rate te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_mig_input = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = 0.5 }
	}
}

# Global Warming: the state's share of the world's emissions last year (a share, owner 2026-11-06): half the color by a fifth of the world's range; a thousand-odd states average 0.1%.
te_jmap_rank_gw_room = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# From the lowest: 0 to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis te_jmap_gw_world > 0 te_jmap_gw_state_emis >= 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_gw_room_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_gw_room_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_gw_room_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis te_jmap_gw_world > 0 te_jmap_gw_state_emis >= 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# Local Climate's penalty before any relief, percent of migration attraction (stored yearly), split at none.
te_jmap_rank_comfort_base = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks

	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = 1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_base_penalty te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_comfort_base_input < 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_comfort_base_input
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_input < te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_comfort_base_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_base_penalty te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_comfort_base_input < 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_low }
	}
	# Above it, the nearest first: 0.5 up to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_base_penalty te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_comfort_base_input > 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_comfort_base_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_comfort_base_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_comfort_base_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_climate_base_penalty te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_comfort_base_input > 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_up }

	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_trade_capacity > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# Investment, what the state's owners pay into the Investment Pool a week, estimated: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 1) to its high.
te_jmap_rank_invest = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# From the lowest: 0 to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_inv_cap te_jmap_invest_value > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_invest_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_invest_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_invest_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_jmap_inv_cap te_jmap_invest_value > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# Standard of Living less Wealth, the yearly walk's, split at none.
te_jmap_rank_sol_wealth = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# Below the midpoint, the nearest first: 0.5 down to 0.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = 1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol has_variable = te_dg_wealth has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_wealth_input < 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_sol_wealth_input
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_input < te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol has_variable = te_dg_wealth has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_wealth_input < 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_low }
	}
	# Above it, the nearest first: 0.5 up to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol has_variable = te_dg_wealth has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_wealth_input > 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_sol_wealth_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_wealth_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_sol_wealth_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol has_variable = te_dg_wealth has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_wealth_input > 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_up }
	}
	# At the midpoint itself: its color.
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_sol has_variable = te_dg_wealth has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_wealth_input = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = 0.5 }
	}
}

# Standard of Living against the expected one, live (average_sol less average_expected_sol), split at none.
te_jmap_rank_sol_expected = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# Below the midpoint, the nearest first: 0.5 down to 0.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = 1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_expected_input < 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_sol_expected_input
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_expected_input < te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_sol_expected_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_expected_input < 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_low }
	}
	# Above it, the nearest first: 0.5 up to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_expected_input > 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_sol_expected_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_sol_expected_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_sol_expected_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_expected_input > 0 has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share_up }
	}
	# At the midpoint itself: its color.
	every_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes te_jmap_sol_expected_input = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = 0.5 }
	}
}

	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_vacant_jobs > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# The share of the state's people below their expected standard of living, 0-1, live.
te_jmap_rank_below_sol = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# From the lowest: 0 to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_below_sol_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_below_sol_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_below_sol_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { state_population > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_class_machinists_share_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_machinists has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes has_variable = te_jmap_rank }
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_share }
	}
}

# Laborers, their people (the yearly walk's): the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 10 people) to its high.
te_jmap_rank_class_laborers = {
	set_global_variable = te_jmap_ranks
	# From the lowest: 0 to 1.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = -1000000000 }
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cls_laborers var:te_dg_cls_laborers > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_class_laborers_input_neg
		min = 0
		max = 5000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { te_jmap_class_laborers_input > te_jmap_rank_prev }
			change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_i add = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_prev value = te_jmap_class_laborers_input }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_jmap_rank value = te_jmap_rank_place }

# The pick's places, if it is fitted to the world.
te_jmap_refresh_rank = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 1 }
		te_jmap_rank_turmoil = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 2 }
		te_jmap_rank_literacy = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 3 }
		te_jmap_rank_e0 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 4 }
		te_jmap_rank_tfr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 5 }
		te_jmap_rank_median = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 6 }
		te_jmap_rank_devastation = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 7 }
		te_jmap_rank_natural = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 8 }
		te_jmap_rank_cdr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 9 }
		te_jmap_rank_cbr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 10 }
		te_jmap_rank_imr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 12 }
		te_jmap_rank_sex = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 13 }
		te_jmap_rank_mig = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 14 }
		te_jmap_rank_old = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 15 }
		te_jmap_rank_urban = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 16 }
		te_jmap_rank_gini = yes
